expect.filtered_text: Had symptoms for the past 10 years

rationale: A duration, not an age. The post-filter drops a numeric-plus-unit match with no age context in its window.
This is the main false-positive risk for this filter: durations share the surface form of ages.
A spelled-out duration. Matched by the pattern but dropped for lack of age context, mirroring the numeric case.
'coverage' ends in the letters 'age'. The label pattern requires a word boundary, so this must not match.
A hyphen is a valid label separator, so a date must not be reinterpreted as a labelled age.
A bare four-digit year is not an age.
Guards against widening the age patterns until they swallow calendar years.
